items.title: Bonus Hollander POTD Reggie Lewis. Dunbar HS grad was drafted 22nd by BOS from Northeastern in 87. After 1 yr on bench, turned into star. Had 18 ppg from 88-93 & was all-star in 92. Good all-around player who did everything well. Sadly died in 93. RIP.
